text: Root cause 1 of the Mem0 fix: the local mem0ai package had been upgraded to 2.0.7, which removed top-level user_id/limit parameters — search must now use top_k plus filters={user_id}, get_all must use filters, while delete_all/add still use top-level user_id

User fixed the unavailable Mem0 cross-agent memory system in the ai-instructure/.memory project, identifying three root causes and verifying the fix by successfully running the list, add, and search subcommands
Root cause 2 of the Mem0 fix: the LLM model deepseek-chat configured in config.py had been discontinued, so it was changed to deepseek-flash while keeping base_url as https://api.deepseek.com/v1

Root cause 3 of the Mem0 fix: line 33 of .gitignore listed .memory/, ignoring the whole directory so mem.py and config.py never entered version control and could not sync across machines; it was narrowed to ignore only .memory/qdrant, history.db, __pycache__, and the root .env

【ai-instructure/工作区治理】2026-10-24 把工作区改造成可迁移形态。1) 重写 .gitignore 并从索引移除 1150 个构建产物（跟踪文件 1640→512），APK 与 keystore 移出索引；2) 新增 projects.yaml（21 个项目清单）、bootstrap.sh（环境检查/子模块/依赖）、.env.example；3) 重写 README 与 AGENTS 记忆 SOP，根目录会话记录归档到 docs/sessions，汇报归档到 docs/reports，新增 mira-automation 备份原本写在第三方 Mira/scripts 里的 4 个脚本；4) 记忆系统改为 .memory/ledger.jsonl 为真相源、qdrant 仅作可重建索引，add 先写账本；MEM0_DIR 固定到 .memory/.cache 以适配 DSH 沙箱。关键决策：账本入库、索引不入库；6 个独立克隆与 2 个真子模块并存，暂不做迁移。踩坑：mem0 会往 ~/.mem0 写迁移目录，沙箱下 PermissionError，用 MEM0_DIR 解决。
